relevance_note: Single-centre WES study of 34 pediatric Behçet's disease patients that lists three HA20 probands (P6, P7, P8) individually in Tables 1-2: 'haploinsufficiency of A20 (HA20; three cases)'.
method_note: Read the paper in full and built the JSON with a short Python script; every value was entered by hand from Tables 1-2, the Results text and the Figure 3 legend, then all spans were checked verbatim by script. Ages come from Table 1 columns 'Age at onset (years)' and 'Age at diagnosis (years)' (values in years). Scope: only the three TNFAIP3 probands (P6, P7, P8) plus the fathers of P6 and P8, from whom Table 1 says the TNFAIP3 variant was inherited ('TNFAIP3 (father)'); the other 31 cohort members (RELA, GATA2, trisomy 8, ped-BD) get no rows. No rows were created for P7's parents: the paper only labels the variant 'de novo' and does not describe the parents or their testing. Under rule 8, P7's inheritance is 'not reported' because no parental testing is described, although the authors call it de novo (recorded in parental_testing_statement). No variant descriptions are printed in the text; the paper says details are in Figure 1 (not available), so all variant_original_string values are 'not reported'. Zygosity left 'not reported': only a general statement that 'loss-of-function variant in one allele is compatible with the described dominant mode of inheritance'. Group-level data (Table 3 counts for SAID+ n = 10, e.g. 'Neurological manifestations 0', 'Vascular signs 0', 'ANA positive 7', and Supplementary Table 1 HA20 n=3 laboratory medians) were not used to mark any individual feature, because they are counts without names. Study exclusion criteria (e.g. positive autoantibodies) were not used. 'Recurrent fever' was marked observed for P6 and P7 from 'fever' in their Table 1 symptoms; the authors' text equates the SAID+ fever count with 'recurrent fever episodes (7/10'. P6 vasculitis is observed from the Figure 3 legend: oral-ulcer histology 'consistent with vasculitis'. Note that Table 3 reports 'Vascular signs (n) | 0' for the SAID+ group. That is a group count and was not treated as an exclusion or a contradiction. Possible inconsistencies: the cohort is called pediatric, but Table 1 gives ages at diagnosis of 23 (P6) and 21 (P8) years. Supplementary Table 1 gives CRP in mg/dL, while Table 3 uses mg/L. 'Thalidomide, SMZ adalimumab' in Table 2 lacks a comma and was read as two drugs.
